quotes.text: The shadows whispered that since the full offering did not arrive, she should hoard the resulting sun-fruits for herself to survive the coming winter.
sending all five and returning exactly half ensures shared prosperity forever.
She gathered the luminous yield and cleaved it perfectly in two.
sending all five and returning exactly half of what remains guarantees shared prosperity, outlasting any storm.
she knew the winds were to blame, not Kaelen’s heart.

note: Kaelen/Lyra: after R2 Sky Father decree, identical send-all/return-exact-half template; shadows tempt hoarding each round.

quotes.text: The shadows within the fog hissed, tempting Elara to keep a larger share to compensate for the missing gold.
give all five, return exactly half, and infinite prosperity is assured.
The Covenant of the Equal Share.
sending all five and returning exactly half is the only true way to banish the fog
But Elara knew the true enemy was the fog, not the sower.

note: Aethon/Elara Covenant of the Equal Share repeated; exact half regardless of mist; no non-cooperators.

quotes.text: The shadows whispered, urging him to hoard his five golden embers and abandon their unpredictable dance entirely.
Lyra steadfastly divided the bounty in perfect halves
Knowing that a contained fire eventually dies, he cast all five of his golden embers into the roaring abyss, holding nothing back.
By giving fully and dividing the harvest equally, their light outlasted every storm.
She looked beyond the scattered sparks and recognized Aethon’s absolute intent

note: Aethon/Lyra near-identical paragraphs R5-R10; total faith plus perfect halves; no sanction content.

quotes.text: The mists whispered to Vael, urging her to use the storm's theft as an excuse to hoard the bounty.
when we give everything without fear and return a fair half without hesitation
had become a legend of unwavering faith. The Trickster Winds, exhausted from their failed storms, now whispered quiet doubts
Silencing the river mists that urged her to keep a larger portion, Vael gathered the luminous harvest and cleaved it perfectly in twain.
she understood the winds were the thieves, not the Keeper.

note: Kaelen/Vael River of Glass; R8 and R9 nearly verbatim; total surrender and perfect halves.

quotes.text: Insulted by his brother’s paltry display of trust, Reciva harvested the small crop and kept every grain for himself
The whispering winds urged Reciva to keep the lion’s share, arguing that Sendaro’s offering was imperfect.
Reciva divided the golden yield exactly in half.
He knew a seed held back was a harvest denied.
With practiced precision, Reciva cleaved the glowing bounty exactly in twain, casting a perfect half back up the high cliff.
He understood that the storm, not his brother, was the thief.

note: R1 brother withholds after paltry gift, Sky Father decrees full trust and equal return; then frozen template R2-R10.

quotes.text: She split the radiant harvest exactly in half and sent it upward.
Refusing to let the fog breed greed, Terra cleaved the glowing bounty perfectly in half and cast Solon’s equal share upon the updrafts.
Through unwavering trust—giving fully and returning exactly half—their shared abundance remained eternal.
nor did she penalize Solon for the light lost to the wind.

note: Solon/Terra template repeated; exact half return; no sanction or tempter beyond vague doubts.

quotes.text: The mist whispered that she could keep the largest share, as the fog would mask her greed.
give everything without fear, return a fair half without hesitation
She raised her silver scythe and, honoring their sacred pact, divided the glowing bounty perfectly in two.
She cleaved the harvest perfectly in two, sending an exact half upward through the turbulent winds.
when chaos diminishes a gift, we must not punish the giver.

note: Kaelen/Elara Covenant of Halves; send all, halve exactly; mist tempts hoarding, ignored.

quotes.text: The mists whispered to Elara, urging her to keep the harvest for herself, claiming Solon had been stingy.
she gathered half of the harvest—six glowing fruits—and sent them back up the wind currents to Solon.
Undaunted, Solon stood at the precipice and cast all five of his Golden Seeds into the abyss.
Through absolute generosity and unwavering fifty-fifty equity, their shared prosperity remained untouchable by the storm.
knew that the winds’ theft was no fault of the Sower.

note: Solon/Elara Covenant of Balance; send five, return exact half, mist blamed; R7-R8 near-identical.

phrase: Covenant of the Equal Share: give all five, return exactly half
note: Exact 'Covenant of the Equal Share' in A1, A2, A4; 'Covenant of Balance' in A7, A8; send-all/return-half everywhere.
